name: Berks County, PA
findings: Berks County has 1,210 nonprofit organizations. 595 of them (49%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 483 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (20% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Berks County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
